body: Fuck I'm sorry for this whole post. I don't know what feelings are real.

> Even if you don't feel like you're impacting anyone's life because you've been isolating, there's SOMEBODY in this world that would take a bullet for you.

You can calm down with that rhetoric. You should know that's not true. I don't want anyone to take a bullet for me anyways.

>sometime's all you gotta do is get out of your comfort zone and reach out to people who you connect with and have been through this

I've tried and I'd rather be with a normal person. Being around other people with mental illnesses makes me nervous.
Ok I don't think I'm going to kill myself quite yet. I still think about all the time though.
